technique_name: Write a 100 word paragraph on the importance of science education.
description: Science education is vital for any society that wants to prosper. Without it, the tremendous advances of the past two centuries simply could not have been achieved and the world would be far behind. Through science, we have been able to extend lifespans, fight dangerous diseases, explore and understand the universe, develop new technologies, and much more.
